intro: A collection of my thoughts, observations, and quick notes on writing, code, and life.

jots.title: Are AI's Purposefully Ridiculous?
jots.content: I've almost given up on every image and video I've tried to create with generative AI. It's got me thinking. Sometimes, it gets so close to what I imagined but, I make one slight change, and the whole thing just becomes silly. Is that on purpose? Do they deliberately screw things up so remarkably to get us to keep creating? They do that with social media, rage baiting. They do that with tech, forcing us to upgrade. Is it out of the realm of possibility that this "AI Boom" is simply more of the same?
